metadata.title: Support The Project
metadata.description: Support the volunteer team behind Bannerlord Coop through Patreon, Buy Me a Coffee, PayPal, Afdian, or Boosty.
hero.heading: Support Bannerlord Coop
hero.description: Bannerlord Coop is developed by a volunteer team and will always be available for free. Contributions help us sustain the work behind the shared campaign, never gate access to it.
community.description: Every contribution gives the team more room to build.
expenses.heading: Keeping the campaign running
expenses.description: Support helps cover development tools, hosting infrastructure, dedicated servers, distribution costs, and other project expenses.
expenses.development.label: Development tools
expenses.development.detail: Software and services used to build, test, and maintain the mod.
expenses.hosting.label: Hosting infrastructure
expenses.hosting.detail: Reliable services that keep project resources available.
expenses.servers.label: Dedicated servers
expenses.servers.detail: Stable environments for development, testing, and the community.
expenses.distribution.label: Distribution costs
expenses.distribution.detail: The systems needed to deliver updates to players.
expenses.other.label: Other expenses
expenses.other.detail: Practical project costs that help the volunteer team keep moving.
otherSupport.heading: Financial support is completely optional.
otherSupport.description: Playing the mod, reporting bugs, creating content, and sharing Bannerlord Coop also help the project tremendously.
otherSupport.thanks: Thank you for supporting Bannerlord Coop!
